name: Aida Ikumi
source:
A first-year student at the school.

She's one of the top honor students at school, and with both good looks and a great personality, there's no shortage of male students hoping to make her their partner for extracurricular activities.

She's the complete opposite of the protagonist, so why does she approach him so much...?

Currently A-rank.

[Translated from [url=https://www.alicesoft.com/hoken/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
